sources.title: The effects of self-myofascial release using a foam roll or roller massager on joint range of motion, muscle recovery, and performance: a systematic review
sources.journal: The International Journal of Sports Physical Therapy
sources.notes: Reviews evidence indicating that self-myofascial release tools can enhance joint range of motion (ROM) and the recovery process by decreasing delayed onset muscle soreness.

sources.title: Influence of static stretching on hamstring flexibility in healthy young adults: Systematic review and meta-analysis
sources.notes: Concludes that static stretching is effective in increasing hamstring flexibility and passive knee extension in healthy young adults.

sources.title: A gait analysis of simulated knee flexion contracture to elucidate knee-spine syndrome
sources.notes: Analyzes how knee flexion contractures significantly influence three-dimensional trunk kinematics during standing and walking, contributing to spinal imbalance.

sources.title: Effects of Joint Mobilization on Pain, Range of Motion, and Function in Patients with Knee Osteoarthritis: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
sources.notes: Demonstrates that joint mobilization significantly improves knee pain and dysfunction in KOA patients, though it does not significantly surpass control groups in purely increasing knee mobility.

sources.title: Associations of self-report physical function with knee strength and knee range-of-motion in total knee arthroplasty: possible nonlinear and threshold effects
sources.notes: Evaluates nonlinear associations and distinct threshold points between knee extensor strength, range of motion, and physical function post-surgery.
